# lumos_app_categories (Data Source)

The categories an app can have.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The categories a custom app can be given.
data "lumos_app_categories" "all" {}

output "category_labels" {
  value = [for c in data.lumos_app_categories.all.app_categories : c.label]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `app_categories` (Attributes List) Every category an app can belong to, ordered by label. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--app_categories))

<a id="nestedatt--app_categories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `app_categories`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String) The category name. This is the exact string the `category` field reports on `GET /v1/apps` and `GET /v1/apps/{app_uuid}`.
